description: Connect native Coding Agent sessions and unified Secretary to the ADE workbench.
secretaryDescription: Global ADE Secretary with live viewport awareness, macro control, and full slash commands.
codexDescription: Your installed Codex engine, configuration, and conversations.
claudeDescription: Your installed Claude Code engine, configuration, and conversations.
kiloDescription: Your installed Kilo Code engine, configuration, and conversations.
opencodeDescription: Your installed OpenCode engine, configuration, and conversations.
dshDescription: Your installed DeepSeek Harness engine, configuration, and conversations.
antigravityDescription: Your installed Google Antigravity engine, configuration, and conversations.
clineDescription: Your installed Cline engine, configuration, and conversations.
piDescription: Your installed Pi engine, configuration, and conversations.
cmdStatus: Show live ADE viewport, focused project, Secretary engine, and session counts.
cmdProjects: List all ADE projects and their active session counts.
cmdSessions: List ADE sessions and their organizational ranks across projects.
cmdFocus: Focus a project folder in ADE (e.g. /focus Aexus-Code).
cmdHome: Exit Focus mode and return to the global ADE Home overview.
cmdNew: Create a new ADE Agent session (e.g. /new claude).
cmdEngine: View or switch Secretary's underlying Coding Agent engine (e.g. /engine claude).
cmdReset: Reset Secretary's conversation context while preserving the selected engine.
cmdInit: Initialize or update project agent instructions (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md).
cmdCompact: Compact conversation history to free up context window.
cmdReview: Review uncommitted code changes and potential issues in the active project.
cmdPlan: Draft a step-by-step architecture and implementation plan before making edits.
cmdClear: Clear the current engine conversation history and start a fresh turn.
cmdModel: Inspect or switch model configuration in the underlying engine.
cmdMcp: Inspect configured MCP servers and available tools.
cmdMemory: Inspect or update persistent project and user memory.
cmdCost: Show token usage and session cost summary.
cmdDoctor: Run diagnostics on the active Coding Agent engine and CLI.
cmdDiff: Summarize current Git changes in the active project.
cmdSkills: List discovered project and user slash commands and skills (.claude/commands, .agents/skills).
cmdMission: List active ADE Missions and their live runtime status (e.g. /mission).
cmdInbox: Show pending ADE Inbox user gates and escalations.
cmdHelp: List all available Secretary macro commands and native engine slash commands.
cliPathsDescription: Optional paths to the installed Coding Agent executables. Empty entries are discovered from the shell environment. Engine credentials and model configuration remain managed by each engine.
